text: Walmart reports 6% holiday-quarter sales growth and adjusted EPS above estimates, while issuing full-year earnings guidance below consensus. U.S. e-commerce rises 27% to 23% of sales. Amazon surpasses Walmart in annual revenue as digital and advertising streams expand.

text: United Airlines revises MileagePlus to increase mile accrual and discounted award access for customers holding United credit cards while reducing earning rates for non-cardholders. Basic economy tickets no longer accrue miles for non-cardholders. Changes take effect April 2.

meta.note: Inversion reflects reward hierarchy shift from distance-based to card-status prioritization.
